rows.name: accounting_events
rows.sql: CREATE TABLE accounting_events (event_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, rep_id INTEGER, delta_base TEXT, created_at INTEGER)

rows.name: asset_locks
rows.sql: CREATE TABLE asset_locks (asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, holder TEXT NOT NULL, acquired_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

rows.name: bridge_ops
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE bridge_ops (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  src20_tick TEXT NOT NULL,
  stamp_asset TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount TEXT NOT NULL,
  burn_txid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  release_txid TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at INTEGER
)

rows.name: canonical_assets
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE canonical_assets (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source_chain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bitcoin',
  source_protocol TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'src-20',
  exact_ticker TEXT NOT NULL,
  tick_hash TEXT,
  deploy_tx TEXT,
  deploy_block INTEGER,
  max_supply TEXT,
  mint_limit TEXT,
  decimals INTEGER DEFAULT 18,
  minted_supply TEXT,
  holder_count INTEGER,
  deployer_address TEXT,
  verification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified',
  canonical_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'indexed',
  whitelisted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  metadata_json TEXT,
  first_seen_at INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER,
  UNIQUE(source_chain, source_protocol, deploy_tx)
)

rows.name: collateral_ledger
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE collateral_ledger (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  canonical_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  direction TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount TEXT NOT NULL,
  btc_txid TEXT,
  dest_chain TEXT,
  dest_tx TEXT,
  vault_address TEXT,
  confirmations INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at INTEGER, burn_txid TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (canonical_id) REFERENCES canonical_assets(id),
  UNIQUE(direction, btc_txid, dest_tx)
)

rows.name: consumed_burns
rows.sql: CREATE TABLE consumed_burns (burn_txid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chain TEXT, canonical_id INTEGER, purpose TEXT, owner TEXT, amount TEXT, created_at INTEGER)

rows.name: operations
rows.sql: CREATE TABLE operations (op_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, action TEXT, canonical_id INTEGER, amount TEXT, chain TEXT, recipient TEXT, state TEXT, tx_id TEXT, result_json TEXT, created_at INTEGER, updated_at INTEGER)

rows.name: pools
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE pools (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  chain TEXT NOT NULL,
  pair_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  canonical_a INTEGER NOT NULL,
  canonical_b INTEGER NOT NULL,
  token_a TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_b TEXT NOT NULL,
  symbol_a TEXT,
  symbol_b TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER, kind_a TEXT DEFAULT 'rep', kind_b TEXT DEFAULT 'rep',
  UNIQUE(chain, canonical_a, canonical_b)
)

rows.name: representations
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE representations (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  canonical_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  dest_chain TEXT NOT NULL,
  dest_address TEXT,
  dest_symbol TEXT,
  dest_name TEXT,
  authority_model TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_DEPLOYED',
  deploy_tx TEXT,
  deployed_at INTEGER,
  initiator_address TEXT,
  circulating_supply TEXT DEFAULT '0',
  notes TEXT,
  updated_at INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (canonical_id) REFERENCES canonical_assets(id),
  UNIQUE(canonical_id, dest_chain)
)

rows.name: stamp_bridges
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE stamp_bridges (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  src20_tick TEXT NOT NULL,
  stamp_asset TEXT NOT NULL,
  stamp_protocol TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'counterparty',
  ratio TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  burn_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  note TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER
)

rows.name: supported_chains
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE supported_chains (
  chain TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  release_gate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  live INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)

rows.name: idx_collateral_btc_txid
rows.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_collateral_btc_txid ON collateral_ledger(btc_txid) WHERE btc_txid IS NOT NULL
